finding.summary: Rebuilding the formula string from `extractTokens` output can corrupt formulas whose token text is not verbatim source (whitespace runs, quoted string literals)
finding.evidence: formula.ts `expandUnboundedRanges` concatenates `token.text` for every token and prepends `'='` (`return '=' + body;`). This is only safe if `extractTokens` returns strictly verbatim text for every token and covers all gaps — the grammar `-> skip`s WS, and STRING tokens are also used as gap fillers, so any normalization (dropped whitespace, unquoted string text) silently rewrites the user's formula whenever a single unbounded ref is present. It also assumes tokens exclude the leading '='; if not, the result is '==…'.
